mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.username, e.password, e.name, e.gender, e.phone, e.job, e.salary, e.image, e.entry_date, e.dept_id, d.name AS dept_name, e.create_time, e.update_time FROM emp e LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.dept_id = d.id ORDER BY e.id

SELECT e.id, e.username, e.password, e.name, e.gender, e.phone, e.job, e.salary, e.image, e.entry_date, e.dept_id, d.name AS dept_name, e.create_time, e.update_time FROM emp e LEFT JOIN dept d ON e.dept_id = d.id WHERE e.id = #{id}
